relationships.subject: Closed head injury
relationships.evidence_quote: closed head injury induces only transient cephalic tactile hypersensitivity, with no extracephalic consequences

relationships.subject: Multimodal traumatic brain injury
relationships.evidence_quote: produces long-term tactile hypersensitivity and widespread sensitization

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: the 3CHI3d mice treated with subthreshold CGRP one week after injury displayed a robust and significant decrease in thresholds, compared to both the sham group receiving the same dose, and the 3CHI3d group receiving vehicle

relationships.subject: Sodium nitroprusside
relationships.evidence_quote: While the non-noxious dose did not induce any threshold change in sham animals, it did significantly decrease thresholds of 3CHI3d mice at 119 days post-injury

key_findings: Multimodal TBI causes persistent cephalic and extracephalic tactile hypersensitivity, whereas closed head impact causes only transient cephalic hypersensitivity
After closed head injury mice show prolonged hypersensitivity to subthreshold CGRP and SNP, supporting a role for CGRP in post-traumatic headache
